# Site identity
> Hernández Contreras, Martínez & Fitch, Abogados, S.C. (trading as HCM&F Abogados) is a Mexico City law firm founded in 1972 with more than 50 years of practice. The firm advises companies and individuals in corporate, civil, commercial, criminal, tax, and administrative matters, and is led by its partners directly. The firm operates primarily in Spanish and English.

# Pages (canonical order, by importance)
- [Home (Español)](https://www.hcmyf.mx/): Site root, Spanish primary language. Hero, 8 practice areas, 18-attorney team, contact form, WhatsApp widget, address, hours.
- [Home (English)](https://www.hcmyf.mx/en/): English mirror of the site root.
- [Aviso de Privacidad (Spanish only, LFPDPPP-compliant)](https://www.hcmyf.mx/avisoprivacidad.html): Privacy notice covering the 10 sections required by Mexican law (Art. 15 LFPDPPP). Includes data subject rights (ARCO), contact channels, and transfer policies.

# Practice areas (8 total, in order of appearance on the site)
- Asesoría Corporativa / Corporate Advice
- Asesoría en Comercio Exterior y de Comunicaciones / Advice in Foreign Trade and Transport
- Asesoría y Litigio Administrativo y Migratorio / Administrative and Migratory Litigation
- Consultoría y Litigio Fiscal / Counsel and Tax Litigation
- Materia Civil y Familiar / Civil and Family Law
- Materia Mercantil / Commercial Law
- Materia Penal / Criminal Law
- Materia de Telecomunicaciones / Telecommunications Matter
